subject: ICT
title: How Many More Needed to Become 10?
subtitle: Making ten
hero_picture: A Kerala girl making an Athapookkalam flower carpet in front of a tiled house, with a cat beside her, palm trees around.

sections.heading: Days to Onam
text: Today is Atham. Onam is 10 days after Atham.
Meenu makes a pookkalam every day.
How many days are left for Thiruvonam?
sections.caption: Making the pookkalam
sections.picture: A girl arranging a round Athapookkalam of colourful flower petals in front of a Kerala house.

sections.heading: Count to ten
text: Mark each day on the calendar.
4 days are over. How many more to reach 10?
sections.caption: Counting days on the calendar
sections.picture: A wall calendar with ten plain squares in a row, some crossed off with a red pencil, a small flower drawn in the last square (no numbers).

sections.heading: Ten fingers
text: Show 7 fingers. How many are folded?
sections.caption: Making ten with fingers
sections.picture: Ten fingers of two hands: 7 fingers raised in yellow and 3 fingers folded, showing 7 and 3 make 10.

sections.heading: Find ten's complement
text: Then click the question mark to complete 10.
sections.caption: The ten game
sections.picture: A laptop screen with a wooden board showing number tiles and empty boxes in addition rows (no readable digits).

sections.heading: Pairs that make 10
text: Learn the pairs: 5 and 5, 1 and 9, 2 and 8.
sections.caption: Ten mangoes
sections.picture: Ten mangoes in a row: 6 yellow and 4 green, children counting them.

rhyme: Seven and three, ten for me,
Eight and two, ten for you,
Nine and one, ten is fun,
activity: Take 10 buttons. Split them into two heaps in different ways and write each pair.
talk: How many days are there from Atham to Onam?
Can you find a pair that makes 10?
summary: Two numbers can join to make 10: 1 and 9, 2 and 8, 3 and 7, 4 and 6, 5 and 5.

questions.prompt: 4 days are over. How many more to make 10?
How many fingers do we have in all?
